title: Motor start/stop with seal-in
summary: Start a conveyor motor with a momentary Start button, keep it running after the button is released, and stop it with a normally closed Stop button or the overload relay.
objectives: Latch a motor contactor with a seal-in (self-holding) path
Use a normally closed Stop button so a broken wire stops the motor
Give Stop and the overload relay priority over Start
starterProgram:
PROGRAM Main
VAR_INPUT
    StartPB : BOOL;       (* Start S1, normally open: TRUE while pressed *)
    StopPB : BOOL;        (* Stop S2, normally closed: TRUE while NOT pressed *)
    MotorFeedback : BOOL; (* Contactor auxiliary contact *)
    OverloadOK : BOOL;    (* Overload relay contact: TRUE while healthy *)
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    MotorContactor : BOOL; (* Contactor coil K1 *)
    RunLamp : BOOL;        (* Green run lamp H1 *)
END_VAR

(* Start the motor with StartPB and keep it running after the button is released. *)

END_PROGRAM
instructions: Pressing Start (StartPB becomes TRUE) energizes MotorContactor.
The motor keeps running after Start is released (seal-in).
Pressing Stop (StopPB becomes FALSE) de-energizes MotorContactor. Stop wins when both buttons are pressed.
An overload trip (OverloadOK becomes FALSE) stops the motor and it must not restart by itself.
RunLamp shows that the motor is running.
hints: A seal-in reads the output itself: MotorContactor := (StartPB OR MotorContactor) AND ...;
StopPB is TRUE while the button is NOT pressed, so use StopPB directly in the AND chain, not NOT StopPB.
The auxiliary contact MotorFeedback confirms that the contactor really pulled in. It is a good source for the lamp.

criteria.title: Start energizes the contactor
criteria.onFail: MotorContactor did not switch on after StartPB became TRUE.

criteria.title: The motor keeps running after Start is released
criteria.onFail: The motor stopped when Start was released. Add a seal-in path through MotorContactor.

criteria.title: Stop de-energizes the contactor
criteria.onFail: The motor kept running after Stop was pressed. Remember: StopPB is FALSE while Stop is pressed.

criteria.title: Stop has priority over Start
criteria.onFail: The contactor switched on while Stop was held. Stop must always win.

criteria.title: An overload trip stops the motor
criteria.onFail: The contactor stayed energized after the overload relay tripped. Include OverloadOK in the logic.

criteria.title: The run lamp shows the running motor
criteria.onFail: The motor was running but RunLamp did not switch on.
